entities.name: Garulsz
entities.description: Ogre bartender of the Backwater tavern who later became a prospector in the Utvara Flats.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Wojek who frequented the Backwater and later bought a tower in the Utvara Flats; Garulsz attended his funeral.

entities.name: Backwater
entities.description: Tenth District tavern run by Garulsz.

entities.name: Bell Borca
entities.description: Came to pick up Kos for his promotion.

entities.name: Utvara Flats
entities.description: Place where Garulsz and Kos met again.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: Accompanied Kos toward the rescue of Crix.

entities.name: Crix
entities.description: Person Kos and Pivlic sought to rescue.

events.summary: The drunk Agrus Kos picks a fight with a polite minotaur in Garulsz's tavern and is thrown into the chandelier.
events.quote: Kos ended up being thrown into the tavern's sturdy chandelier

events.summary: Twelve years later Garulsz and Kos meet again in the Utvara Flats.
events.quote: Garulsz and Kos happened upon each other again in the Utvara Flats

events.summary: Garulsz helps guide Kos and Pivlic toward the rescue of Crix.
events.quote: She helped guide Kos and Pivlic on their way toward the rescue of Crix

events.summary: Garulsz takes part in Kos's funeral procession.
events.quote: She also participated in Kos's funeral prosession a few days later.

relations.note: Was bartender at the tavern he frequented.
relations.quote: Garulsz was the ogre bartender of the Backwater
